row.text:
Once upon a time there was a fox. He was very restless and kept moving all night long. He wanted to take a break so he decided to lie down under a tree and take a nap.

He laid down and started to yawn. The yawns were long and deep. He felt so relaxed that soon he was fast asleep.

But the fox couldn't stay still for long. He started to feel restless again and started running around in circles. He found it very hard to sleep for long.

He tried to take a nap many more times, but the same thing happened over and over. He would get very sleepy and yawn, but then he would get too restless and start jumping around again.

The fox knew he would be better off if he could just relax and stay still in one place. But it was hard!

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. Jane lived on a farm and her best friend was a mule. The mule's name was Joe. Jane and Joe had lots of fun together.

Every day, Jane and Joe would go for a walk in the open fields. They would enjoy the sunshine and play games. Sometimes they would play tag and hide and seek. Other times they would make believe they were knights and dragons.

When they would tire of pretending, they would go to the open barn and take a nap. They would snuggle up close together with the mule's warm fur tickling Jane's face.

Then Jane and Joe would go back to the open fields. They would run and laugh and giggle. Jane and Joe were the best of friends.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a little bird. It had wings and it was very playful. Every day it liked to jump. While it was jumping it would flap its wings to help it stay in the air.

Sometimes the bird flew so high that it could touch the clouds. It would look down and see the world below. It thought it was so much fun to fly.

One day the bird noticed something new. It saw another playful bird flying by. The two birds locked eyes and for a moment they were best friends. Then the other bird flew away.

The bird sadly sat on a branch and started to miss its new friend. But then the other bird flew back. They flew together and jumped over the clouds, playing and having lots of fun.

The two birds flew next to each other for the rest of the day, under the sun and stars, until it was time to go back home.

Once there was an old man who wanted to teach the children to play. He decided to teach them to play a pipe. Every day he would visit the children and show them how to make music by blowing into the pipe. Popular tunes would fill the air.

The children loved playing the pipe. They would practice everyday until they could make music just like the old man. With time, they even began making up their own tunes. Everyone in town started to enjoy the sweet songs coming from the children's pipes.

Soon, the old man became very popular. Everywhere he went, people would say hello and thank him for teaching the children to play the pipe. The old man was so proud of the children and the music that they had made.

The old man and the children continued to make music and play their pipes. It was a happy time for all of them.

Once there was a little girl named Lucy. She was 3 years old and liked to explore. One day Lucy was walking in the park and looking around. She saw an olive. It was a big, round, green olive. Lucy thought it was interesting so she picked it up. 

When she looked closer, she saw that the olive was not completely green. It had a bit of pink on it. She was really excited. She thought it looked like a special kind of olive. 

Lucy wanted to show her mom, so she went home. When she got home she showed her mom what she had found. She was really proud of her special olive. 

The next day, Lucy took the olive back to the park. She wanted more children to see her special, pink olive. 

From that day on, Lucy always looked for other special olives when she was out exploring.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who loved to build. She had a special box full of blocks so that she could build whatever she wanted.

One day, the girl decided to build a pink swimming pool. She used her blocks to make a square, then she arranged the blocks into a bowl shape. She put the blocks together until the pool was nice and big and looked just the way she wanted it.

When the pool was finished, the girl took off her clothes and jumped in. The water in the pool was nice and cool, and she swam around and splashed for hours.

When the sun started setting, the girl climbed out of the pool and got dressed again. She was tired but very happy. She had built a fun pink swimming pool for herself and she was looking forward to swimming in it again tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a lively cactus named Fred. Fred loved to dance around his cactus patch. Every day, Fred would twirl, spin and bounce around, making the other cacti smile.

One day, Fred hopped out of his cactus patch and started to dance in the nearby meadow. He moved his feet to the side and swayed his arms to the beat of the wind. The birds in the sky flew around and watched Fred dance in circles. 

The other animals in the meadow noticed Fred's lively dancing too and started to dance alongside him. Rabbits hopped around, squirrels jogged back and forth and the deer pranced in graceful circles.

Fred was so happy in the meadow. He was so glad to be able to make the other animals smile with his dancing. He danced until the sun started to set and then made his way back home to the cactus patch. 

And that is how Fred, the lively cactus, became everyone's favorite dancing partner.

One day, a wild mailman was walking along the street when he saw a very special letter on the sidewalk. It was addressed to a 3 year old child. The mailman couldn't help but pick it up to take it to the child.

Once he found the child's house, the mailman knocked on the door and the child opened it. He was so excited to get the letter and thanked the mailman. He then ran off to open it.

Inside, the child found a very fun and special game. He was excited to try it out! He followed all the instructions, and it was fun to complete the puzzle pieces. When he was done, the child felt so proud!

The mailman was so happy to see the child complete the game. He gave him a high five and waved goodbye. The wild mailman then continued on his way with a huge smile on his face.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Abby. She was three years old and she liked to play at night. One night, Abby wanted to go outside, so her mom gave her a flashlight. She was so excited! She held it tightly as she opened the door and stepped outside. 

Suddenly, it was very dark. Abby felt embarrassed and scared, but she held the flashlight up and shone it around. The light made everything better and much brighter. 

Abby began to explore. She found the furry cat hiding in the bushes, and the big bird sleeping in the tree. Everywhere she looked, the flashlight made things easier to see. 

Abby had so much fun exploring with her flashlight. It made her feel brave and not scared anymore. Later she went back inside, still holding the flashlight tightly. The end.

Once upon a time there was an adorable little bear. He lived on the top of a tall mountain. Every day, he would wake up and balance on a log. He did this so he could stand and watch the sun rise. He enjoyed the peaceful morning, and it made him feel happy. 

One day, the little bear decided to go exploring. He tumbled and hopped his way down the mountain. He looked around and found new things to balance on. Everywhere he went, he stopped and tried to balance. He balanced on rocks, logs, and even a big tree branch. 

But then, something special happened. The bear found a big round rock. He stood on it and tried to balance. Suddenly, he was spinning high in the air. Around and around he went and it was so much fun! 

The little bear enjoyed spinning and balancing on the rock. When it was time to go home, he returned to the top of the mountain with a very happy heart.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck. He was very independent and wanted to explore the world. He took his first step away from his mom and dad, and set off on his own. He was so excited!

He walked and walked, until he came to a big field. He saw lots of things to explore and ran around scattering the leaves. He jumped into the puddles and looked for bugs.

He had such a fun adventure. When it was time to go home, he went the wrong way. He became scared and started to cry, but soon felt a warm, comforting beak close to his.

It was his mom, who had come after him. She hugged him tight and said 'I'm so glad you are doing things on your own, but always remember I am here for you.'  Then they both walked home together in the evening sun.

Once there was a girl named Jane who was 3 years old. She was playing in her living room when she came across a beautiful vase. She adored the vase because it was so big and original. She wanted to keep it, so she picked it up and hugged it tight.

Suddenly, Jane noticed a sign near the bottom of the vase. It said "Do Not Touch!" She felt a little scared and confused and decided to put the vase back. As she did, she shrugged her shoulders because she didn't know what to do.

The next day, Jane's mom asked her why she had taken the vase. Jane didn't know so she shrugged her shoulders again. Her mom laughed and explained to her that the vase was very special and that it was the original vase she had gotten for her wedding day.

Jane was so glad she hadn't kept the special vase and she was happy to know that her mom didn't mind. From then on she was more careful when touching things she didn't own and she always shrugged her shoulders when she was feeling unsure.

Once upon a time there was a girl who was going on a picnic. She was feeling very nervous but excited too. She asked her friend to come with her. Her friend said yes and they both got ready.

They packed a picnic bag with food and drinks. They got a map and used it to find their way to the picnic spot. When they arrived they were happy to see some flowers and a big open space. They used their blanket to sit down and enjoy their picnic.

They had so much fun eating their snacks and playing games together. After eating, they lay on the ground and watched the clouds in the sky. They felt so relaxed, it was a perfect day. 

When it was time to go home they were sad, but also excited to go home and use the things they had learned from their picnic.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who had a special question. He asked his parent why the sky was so blue. His parent was very patient and replied, "The sky is blue because the sunlight reflects off the ocean." 

The little boy then asked why there were so many stars in the night. The parent replied, "The stars twinkle and shine at night to keep us safe and remind us of how special we are." 

The little boy was very curious and asked lots more questions. His parent was very patient and answered them all. The little boy listened so carefully and learned a lot about the world around him. 

When the little boy was all done asking questions, his parent gave him a big hug. The little boy felt so happy to have such a patient parent.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jenny. She loved to march like a soldier. She marched around her house every day. 

Sometimes her mom would watch her, and smile. Other times, Jenny's brother would poke her with a stick while she was marching, and that would make her laugh. 

But no matter what happened, Jenny kept marching. She was so patient and didn't give up. She was even more determined to keep marching her second time around. 

Jenny kept getting better and better at marching every day. She still gets better and better with practice. Soon, she will be the best marcher in town!

Once upon a time there was a little girl, who had a nice case. Inside the case was something very special. One day she got a present. She opened up the present and was so happy to receive a surprise. 

Her surprise was a toy car, it was so shiny and bright. She hugged it close and promised to take good care of it. She put it in her case and made sure it was safe. 

The little girl took the case everywhere she went and showed her friends the toy car. Everyone said it was so nice and pretty. 

The little girl was so happy, she thanked her family for the nice surprise and promised to always love it.

Once there was a skin. It was the color of the sun, shiny and bright. But it was hard - so difficult that it hurt if someone touched it.

The skin lay all alone, until one day a little bug came and made a home. The bug loved the skin, and rested their tired legs. But the skin was sad. It wished for someone else to lie with it.

One day, a spider came and saw the skin lying all alone. The spider asked the skin if it could lie with it. The skin was too scared to say yes, so it stayed quiet.

But the spider was brave and went ahead and lay down next to the skin. Together they rested in the sun, happy and content.

Once there was a lonely boy. He didn't have any friends and it made him feel sad.

Every day he would go to the post office and he would look at the pretty stamps. He loved them very much.

One day, he asked the post office clerk if he could please have one of the stamps that he liked. The clerk smiled and said yes. He gave him the stamp and the boy was so happy!

He thanked the clerk and ran out of the post office with his stamp. He kept it in his pocket, and from then on it was his very best friend. He would take it out and look and it, and he knew that he was never alone.

Once there was a chubby little girl named Lisa. She loved to go to the park with her mom. Today, Lisa was very excited to go to the park.

When she got to the park, Lisa saw a brown bag laying on the ground. She picked it up and opened it. Inside the bag were several toys! Lisa was so happy.

That's when she heard a voice. When Lisa turned around, she saw a chubby little turtle. The turtle spoke to Lisa. It asked her if she wanted to play.

Lisa was so excited! She said yes and the two of them played together. They made castles in the sand, swung on the swings and chased each other around. It was the best fun ever. 

When it was time to go home, Lisa thanked the turtle for playing with her. She said goodbye and hugged the turtle. Then she put the brown bag full of toys in her backpack and went home with her mom.

Once upon a time there was a faucet, who wanted to change. But at first, nothing happened. The faucet just sat there, all alone. 

One day, something unusual happened. A stream of water started to flow from the faucet. It wasn't like any other water. It was a rainbow water. 

The faucet was so happy. It was finally changed! Everywhere the faucet went the rainbow water splashed out. Everyone who saw it was amazed. 

The faucet was so proud of what it had changed into. Everywhere it went, it sprayed its rainbow water and made people happy. 

And the faucet lived happily ever after.

Tommy saw a peanut. He was so excited! He wanted to try it and see what it tasted like. But it was bitter. He didn't like the way the peanut tasted. He made a sour face and stuck his tongue out. Tommy decided to leave the peanut alone and keep looking around. He kept on exploring and soon he forgot all about the peanut.

Once there was a cool apron. It was worn by a very happy girl. She was dancing in the park, when something very special happened.

The apron suddenly began to sparkle! She gasped in surprise and everyone around her gathered to watch. They couldnâ€™t believe their eyes as the apron began to float in the air.

The girl laughed and shouted with joy. She spun around in circles with the apron above her head. Everyone cheered and clapped in amazement as the apron went from green to yellow and blue.

Suddenly, the apron dropped back down and the girl was still wearing it. Everyone laughed and said goodbye as they went back to their homes. The girl smiled and hugged her apron, glad that something so cool had happened.

Lizzie was a little girl who loved to play in her garden. One day, she saw a little wagon in the garden. It was so pretty! She figured out how to make it bounce. She hopped in the wagon and started bouncing. She laughed and laughed as she bounced around the garden.

Lizzie bounced higher and higher. She smiled as she felt the wind against her face. Lizzie bounced so high that she ended up in the air! She had never been so high before. 

When she finally came back to earth, her wagon had bounced away. She could see it moving further and further away. She ran after it as fast as she could. But she couldn't catch up!

Finally, Lizzie's parents saw her chasing the little wagon and ran to help her. Daddy caught the wagon and put it back in the garden. Lizzie hugged them and thanked them.

From that day forward, Lizzie and her parents enjoyed playing together in the garden, bouncing around in the little wagon.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess. This princess had an amazing chest. Inside the chest was something special. For hours and hours every day, the princess would raise the lid and look inside.

Once, when the princess opened the chest, she saw a perfect diamond. It was her most treasured item. She kept this precious diamond in the chest and made sure to take good care of it.

The princess wanted to make sure the diamond stayed perfect so by day she used sunshine to help it sparkle and by night she used moonlight to help it shine.

Every day, the princess would admire the diamond and she was proud of her perfect chest. She knew nothing could ever beat it.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl who wanted to do something special. One day, she heard a noise coming from behind the curtain. She peeked around the corner and saw a pretty butterfly. She wanted to catch it, but the butterfly was too quick. She tried to follow it, but the butterfly flew away.

The little girl kept trying though and she didn't want to give up. She put her hands up to the curtain and tried to grab the butterfly. She resisted, but the butterfly fluttered away again.

The girl kept trying to catch the butterfly until it landed on her shoulder. She was so happy she had finally caught it that she didn't even resist when it flew away one last time. She was content with the beautiful moment they shared.

Once there was a naughty girl named Lucy. She had long, brown hair that she liked to pull. One day, she was looking in the mirror, and she couldn't help but pull her hair. Her mom saw her and said "No, Lucy, that's not nice. Let's fix your hair." Lucy's mom combed out her hair and put it into a pretty ponytail. Then, she gave Lucy a big hug and said, "Now you look better!" Lucy was happy that her hair was fixed. From then on, she tried not to be so naughty with her hair!

Once upon a time, there were two metal cars, who wanted to race. The blue car honked and revved its engine as it prepared to start the race. The red car eagerly awaited the starting signal. Finally, the flag went down, and the cars began to race! They sped around the track, going faster and faster.

The blue car zoomed in front of the red car. The red car began to speed up, moving quickly and skillfully. The two cars were very competitive, trying their hardest to win the race. As they raced around the corners, they both honked loudly at each other!

But in the end, the blue car crossed the finish line first. The metal cars cheered and beeped loudly in celebration. The blue car won the competitive race and drove away, happy and proud.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She was three years old and loved to play. One day, she was playing with her toys when she saw something. It was small and moved fast. What was it? It was a little mouse! The mouse ran all around Amy's room and Amy wanted to catch it. She closed the door so the mouse couldn't get away. She wanted the mouse to be her friend. She said, "That mouse is mine!" She opened the door slowly and chased the mouse. She was so fast. She caught it in her hands and said, "I caught you!" But then she shut the door and opened it again quickly. The mouse was gone! That was why she had to shut the door so quickly. Now, Amy and the mouse were friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a serious shop. It stayed in one place, like when you park a car. Every day the shop opened up and sold new things.

One day, a little girl named Lynne wanted to go to the shop. She asked her mom if they could go. Her mom said, "Yes, we can go!"

So they got in their car and parked it near the shop. When they got out, Lynne took her mom's hand and they walked to the shop.

When they got there, Lynne was so excited! She saw all kinds of silly things like colored lollipops and sparkly toys. She wanted to buy something, but her mom told her to be serious and think about what she really needed.

So, Lynne thought carefully, and decided to buy a brush for her dolls. She went up to the counter and paid for her brush with her own money.

When they left the shop, Lynne was very proud of herself for being so serious. She hopped in the car with her new brush and off they drove!

One day, there was a little boy who was frightened. He had never been on a boat before, and his parents wanted him to have an adventure. He was scared but went anyway.

The boat rocked back and forth on the water. He felt scared and a little bit sick. His mom held him close and said, "Don't be frightened. It's ok."

He looked out over the water and saw a big sail. It was white and beautiful. He loved it! His dad said, "Let's go and explore!" 

They all hopped in the boat, and they slowly sailed away. The boat rocked gently, and the sail caught the wind. The little boy felt really happy. He laughed and smiled, not feeling frightened anymore. 

The boat took them all the way around the bay, and the little boy was so proud that he had gone on the adventure. He was so glad he wasn't scared anymore. 

They sailed back to shore, and the little boy felt so brave. He could hardly wait to tell his friends. They had gone on an adventure and rocked on the big white sail. What an adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a modern band. The band made really cool music. All of the people in the town enjoyed listening to the band's music.

One day, while everyone was listening to the band at a concert, a giant bellowing noise filled the air. Everyone looked up and noticed a huge animal in the sky, and it was getting closer and closer!

Suddenly, the band stopped playing, and all of the people started to worry and scream. Then, one brave band member stepped forward and said that he had a plan. He said that he was going to try to rescue the animal!

He asked everyone to clap as loud as they could, so he could find the animal in the sky and bring it down safely. Everyone clapped, and the band member flew up in the air and grabbed the animal. The animal was so happy.

The band member brought the animal down to the ground, and everyone cheered. The band started to play again, and everyone celebrated. The band member was a hero and the modern band was very proud.

One day, Bob was sitting on the floor playing with his toy truck. He saw a small cop outside his window. He went to the window and waved. The cop waved back and then knocked on the door. 

Bob opened the door and the cop asked if he would like to share his toy truck. Bob smiled and said yes. The cop asked if he had any other toys and Bob showed her his collection.

The cop liked what she saw, so she gave Bob a small toy car in return for sharing his truck. Bob was so excited and thanked the cop. He gave the truck to the cop and she waved goodbye. Bob ran inside to show his parents the toy car. They were so proud of him for sharing his toys. 

Bob learned an important lesson that day - that sharing truly is a wonderful thing!

Once there was a little girl. She was only three years old. Every morning, she would pray. She would say, "Please help me be a good person."

One sunny day, she went to the store. In the store she saw a beautiful flower. She asked her mom if she could buy it. But her mom said, "No, it's too expensive."

Then, the little girl said, "I'll pray harder. Maybe then I can get it." So, the girl prayed very hard.

Soon, she saw a cheap flower. It was almost as pretty as the one before. She asked her mom if she could buy it. Her mom said yes, and the girl was very happy. 

The little girl took the flower home. She put it in a special place near her bed. Every morning, she would look at the flower and think, "I prayed and I got my flower. Thank you!"

Once upon a time, there was an enormous lemon. Everyone in the village wanted it for its sweet deliciousness. But when they tried to get it, they found that it was stuck up in a high tree.

The villagers tried everything to get it down but nothing worked. Finally a kind wizard came to the village and said he would help. He waved his magic wand and the lemon flew down from the tree. 

The lemon was too big to fit in the villagers' hands so the wizard conjured up a basket. As soon as they put the lemon inside, the basket started to sparkle and shine. 

The wizard said, "This lemon contains special magic and it will help to restore the village back to its former glory!" 

The villagers cheered with delight as the wizard placed the enormous lemon in the village square. From then on, everyone worked together to bring back the village to its former state. With the help of the magic lemon, the village was restored in no time. 

The villagers still remember that day and the enormous lemon that restored their village.

Once, there was a boy. He liked to run. Everywhere he went, he ran. One day, he saw a pine tree in a park. He liked it, so he ran to it. He reached it and he was so happy. 

He touched the pine needles and he admired its tallness. He started to run around it, admiring the tree. But then, he saw a rabbit nearby. He wanted to say hello, so he ran towards it. 

He was polite and said, "Hello, rabbit!" But the rabbit didn't answer. He was sad but he kept running around the pine. After some time, he said goodbye to the rabbit, and ran back home. 
 
He was happy, he had been kind and polite, and he had seen a wonderful pine tree.

Once there was a little man who wanted to make something special. He found a brown box with a model in it. He wanted to try and make it look even better. So he grabbed some crayons and paper and tried to draw a better model. He worked and worked, and after lots of trying, he made a new model that was even more detailed and special. He was very proud of what he had made. He showed it to his friends who were amazed at how much better it was than the original model. Everyone was impressed with how he managed to try and make something so great!

Molly was in the garden with her brother. There were lots of sparkles in the grass, they were like tiny stars. Molly wanted to pick them up. Suddenly, her brother shouted, "Look!" Molly looked up and saw swirly lines of steel in the sky. They were going so slow, like they had all the time in the world. Molly smiled and laughed with her brother until some of the steel started to scatter. The pieces floated to the ground and scrambled in the grass. Molly and her brother studied the pieces until Molly clapped her hands and exclaimed, "Let's gather them up!" Working together, they slowly filled a bag full of shiny steel. Molly and her brother looked at the pile of steel and smiled. What a wonderful game!

Bessy was hot. She was walking outside and saw a zip in the sky. She waved at it and the zip waved back. She was so excited that she started jumping up and down. She waved again and the zip waved back again. She waved and waved until it flew away. 

Bessy kept walking. Then she saw a dog. The dog was hot too. She waved and the dog waved back. The dog ran around her in circles. It was so fun that she waved again and again. 

At the end of the day, Bessy was tired. But she was happy because she waved so many zips and a hot dog.

Once upon a time there was a jolly flower. The flower wanted to listen to something special. 
The flower bent down and listened closely. Suddenly, it heard the happy singing of a little bird. 
The flower smiled and moved its petals to the rhythm. It swayed back and forth, feeling the music. 
The happy bird continued to sing and the flower jumped up and down to the beat.

At last, the bird finished its song and the flower thanked it for the music. The bird chirped in return and flew away. 
The flower sighed contentedly and thanked the sky for such a jolly sound. Then the flower lay back and enjoyed the peace of the warm summer air.

Once there was a brave little girl. She wanted to explore the world around her. One day, she decided to go on an adventure with her friends. 

They started walking around when they heard a strange noise. Everyone was scared and started running away. 

The brave little girl stopped and decided to take a look. She saw a tiny creature poking its head out from behind a bush. It was a small and fuzzy creature with big eyes.

The brave little girl wanted to learn more and so she slowly walked closer. The creature looked scared and tried to run away. But she said a friendly word. 

The creature stopped and looked back. Soon the brave little girl and the tiny creature became friends. They hugged each other and ran around laughing and playing together. 

They were best friends from then on.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to unpack. One day, she was given a special box from her will. When she opened it, she was so excited. Inside was a dull toy. She quickly unpacked it and flung it around the room. She liked it so much, she decided to keep it forever. The little girl was happy to have a new toy to play with every day. This is why she loves to unpack!

One day, Mommy and Daddy took Sara the 3-year-old to the park. Mommy and Daddy were happy, but Sara was scared. She saw a cop. The cop looked dangerous. Mommy and Daddy talked to the cop. After that, they all walked away together.

Sara didn't know why they talked to the cop. She was too scared to ask. Daddy held her hand tight and told her everything was OK.

When they got home, Daddy told her that the cop was there to keep everyone safe. He said the cop was like a big friend who made sure no-one was in danger.

Sara felt better and knew the cop was there to help keep her safe. She was no longer scared.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mint who was very troubled. Everywhere she went, she carried buckets and bags to collect things.

One day, Mint was walking in the park. She saw a beautiful feather and put it in her bucket. She noticed a pretty stone on the ground and added it to her collection. She even found a tiny shell and added it too!

Mint kept searching the park and came across a big apple tree. Its branches were full of apples. Mint reached up and picked one and put it in her bag. She ate the apple and felt so happy!

Mint kept looking around and finally found the most special item of all - a shiny silver coin! She put it in her collection and went home with a happy heart.

Mint now had a wonderful collection that she could look at and enjoy, and she was no longer troubled.

Once upon a time, there was a brave knight. He had a shiny sword he liked to use. Every day he'd use it to practice his sword fighting. One day he had to use his sword in a real fight. He was scared, but he had to be brave. As the knight took out his sword, he knew he had to be strong. The knight waved his sword and the enemy ran away. He was so proud of himself for using his sword. From then on, the knight was never scared to use his sword. He was always brave, even when things were tough. The end.

One day, Laura was walking home. She saw something unusual. It was a lawyer. She had never seen a lawyer before! 

She was very curious and wanted to get a closer look. She went up to the lawyer and started to talk to him. They talked for a while about different things. 

The lawyer was so friendly and nice. He explained to Laura why he was there. He was helping to make a new law. 

This was something very unusual. But it was exciting too! Laura smiled and thanked the lawyer. Then she said goodbye and closed the door behind her. 

The lawyer waved and smiled as Laura left. She had had an exciting and unusual day. She was glad that she had met the friendly lawyer.

Tommy was sad when his mum stopped drying him. His eyes were upset and he wanted to stay warm. When his mum gave him a warm tube, he was happy again. He smiled as he hugged it tightly. He loved how the tube made him feel nice and dry. He felt much better after snuggling with it. 

Mum was pleased that Tommy was happy again and she said that he could keep the tube. He hugged it over and over, feeling how warm and soft it was. 

Later that night, Tommy was still cuddling his tube. He was having the best time, and he felt so dry! He didn't want anything to upset him again. He always felt safe and happy when he had his tube.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jake. Jake was very excited because he was going on a special safari. He got to wear a new outfit and he couldn't wait to explore the wild jungle. He had never been on a safari before and he was very excited.

On the safari, Jake started to notice that something wasn't right. He started to frown as he looked around. Everywhere he looked, he could see old and dirty animals. He thought they were supposed to be new and unique ones.

Then suddenly, he heard some strange noises coming from the bushes. He walked closer and noticed two beautiful new tigers! He was so happy! He couldn't believe it. He let out a huge smile and the tigers ran away.

After that, Jake continued to explore the safari, and he found more amazing new animals. Finally, it was time to go home, and Jake was so excited about what he had seen. He knew he would never forget his safari adventure.

Sam was very pleased with his joke. He was very proud of being so polite. He had played a fun joke and hadn't hurt anyone's feelings.

Billy was a happy little boy. He had a big, green park near his home that he liked to play in.

One day, he wanted to do something different. He decided to jog around the park! He was so excited! 

He was going through the park, when he looked up and saw a big, shining star. He stopped and smiled. It was so beautiful.

Suddenly, the ground got very messy. Billy looked down and saw it was very muddy. He started to slip and slide as he tried to jog, but it was too much fun! He was laughing so hard.

Billy finished his jog and looked up to the sky again. He waved to the star and said goodbye. He said he'd jog around the park again soon!

Cindy gazed out of her window. She watched the kids playing in the park with a smile. She looked around her room and saw her chess set. It was a gift from her parents and Cindy was very lucky.

Excited, Cindy took out the pieces. She looked at them closely and decided to start a game. She carefully placed all the pieces on the board and then looked up.

Suddenly, she noticed a bird perched on the window sill. It was looking at her with its beady black eyes. Cindy, enchanted by it, started to talk to it. She told it her story and even showed it the game of chess.

The bird watched, fascinated. When Cindy finished, it made a little chirp and flew away. Cindy watched it go, a smile on her face. She was sure the bird was very lucky to have seen her game of chess.

Once there was a little girl, and she was determined to learn how to ride her bike. She was only three, so she was really wobbly when she tried to ride it. Her mom wanted to encourage her, so she showed her how to ride safely. She showed her how to practice on her bike on the white rug in their living room. 

The little girl was a bit scared to try it, but with a few gentle words from her mom, she got on the bike and started to pedal. She swerved around, and had lots of falls, but every time she fell, her mom was there, to help her back up and encourage her to keep going. 

Pretty soon, the little girl mastered it, and she was so proud! She started to ride around the white rug, pumping the pedals confidently and laughing with joy. Her mom cheered, "Well done!" and she gave her a hug. The little girl was delighted that she had made progress, and now she was ready to try riding on the street, too.

Once there was a boy who loved tanks. He found a rare tank one day and it made him very excited. It was so exciting he couldn't wait to show it to his mom and dad. He went to their house but when he arrived he saw that his dad was doing something very special. His dad was working on a giant tank! It was even more rare and exciting than the one the boy had found. The boy was so excited he started to jump up and down. His mom and dad were also very excited and they all played with the tanks together. It was a very special and exciting day.

It was a cloudy day and the sky was dark. Suddenly, it started to rain. People had to take cover from the rain and ran for shelter. But one thief was too shy to do the same. He stood still, getting soaked in the wet rain. He was not brave enough to do anything else. He kept still and shivered. His clothes were wet but he kept still and waited until the rain had stopped. After a while, the rain stopped and the thief could move again. He was still wet, but he managed to escape without being seen.

It was a sunny day. Little Bob was in the garden playing with his toy pistol. He was very eager to try out his new gun. It had a bright yellow cap, and could make a funny noise when it sprayed. 

He wanted to see if the little gun could shoot something. So he found a long piece of string and he held it tightly between his hands. Then he aimed the gun at the string, and he sprayed it with the gun.

Zzzzoom! The gun sprayed the string and Bob was so excited. He sprayed the string again and again and he couldn't stop smiling. He watched as the string went spinning and twisting in the air. 

Bob laughed and ran around in circles as the string spun around him. He had so much fun! After a while, he realised it was getting late and it was time to go in. He put his gun away and ran inside, already excited to come back and play the next day.

Once there was a girl called Jenny. She was always bored, so one day she started looking for something to do. She was walking in the park when she saw some news on the ground. It was gray and old, but it looked very interesting.

Jenny picked up the news and started to look around. Suddenly she saw a big tree with a big door in it. Jenny was excited, so she opened the door and saw a magic world. She could see lots of colorful animals, funny people, and wonderful things to explore.

Jenny started to explore the magical world. She made new friends and saw amazing things. She was so happy to be in the new world!

Jenny stayed in the magical world for a few weeks, until one day the news she had found in the park had disappeared. Jenny felt sad and went back home, but she never forgot what had happened in the magical world.

Once upon a time, there was an ancient castle. Inside the castle was a beautiful garden full of flowers and trees. In the garden there was a special strawberry patch. Every day the prince and princess would walk in the garden and admire the display of strawberries. 

The strawberries were very tasty, and the prince and princess would pick them and eat them. They liked their sweet taste and would laugh as they ate them. Soon the birds heard about the delicious strawberries and would come to take a few to eat. 

The prince and princess liked to share the strawberries with the birds. They would watch as they flew away with the ancient strawberries they had given them. Every day they enjoyed the strawberry display in their garden. They were the happiest prince and princess around!

Mick was so excited. He was three and going to the beach for the first time. When he and his mom arrived, he couldn't believe his eyes. His mom pointed to the cliff that towered over the beach. He felt like a small ant compared to its greatness. He ran towards the cliff and was amazed at the waves crashing against it. He was so enthusiastic to explore. 

Mick's mom watched as he played in the sand and waded in the shallow water. He pointed to the bright, colorful shells as they dotted the sand. Then he noticed a rock wall at the edge of the water. He eagerly ran towards it and touched the cold, jagged stones. His mom smiled as she watched him explore with such enthusiasm. 

Mick's mom finally coaxed him away from the cliff and they drove back home. He was exhausted but happy, and still amazed at his adventure. He couldn't wait to go back and explore again.
